title: 데이터 점검
description: 스프레드시트로 받은 데이터의 무결성과 정제 상태를 점검합니다. 변수명·빈 행, 숫자·날짜·코드 형식, 이상치와 범위·허용 값·선후 규칙, 결측 코드와 중복, 텍스트 표기를 보고, 문제를 고친 사본과 dlookr 진단 보고서를 만듭니다.

assistant.summary: Data integrity and cleaning check of a data frame received as a spreadsheet (dlookr plus the module's own checks): a summary table of problems with fixes; column-name problems, empty rows/columns, constant columns; numbers stored as text, mixed date formats, lost leading zeros in codes; numeric diagnosis, IQR outliers with plot and rows; range, allowed-value and order rules; NA, hidden missing codes, empty required fields, duplicate rows and keys; whitespace, case variants, similar spellings, synonyms, category frequencies; optionally a cleaned copy saved to the session and dlookr's HTML diagnosis report.
